test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 23 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Rohit invested a sum of money at simple interest and it became double itself in 4 frac{1}6 years. The rate of interest per annum was:
solution:
**Given:**

Time (t) = 41/6 years = 25/6 years

Principal (P) = ₹X

Amount (A) = ₹2X

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = P × R × T / 100

A = P + SI

**Calculation:**

Since A = 2P:

SI = A - P = 2P - P = P

Using SI formula:

SI = P × R × T / 100

⇒ P = P × R × (25/6) / 100

⇒ 1 = R × (25/6) / 100

⇒ 1 = R × 25 / 600

⇒ R = (1 × 600) / 25

⇒ R = 24%

**The rate of interest per annum is 24%.**
